result.quote: but if we sit here, we will also die. So come now, let us go over to the camp of the Arameans. If they let us live, we will live; if they kill us, we will die.
result.reason: The key is supported, since the men expected to die if they stayed. However, the passage also gives a distinct defensible reason: going to the Arameans offered a possibility of being allowed to live. The wording is awkward and should be, for example, “Why did the men with leprosy go to the camp of the Arameans?”
